market: Europe Nitrile Rubber (NBR) Elastomeric Foam Market
market_definition: The NBR elastomeric foam market comprises flexible closed-cell foams based on nitrile butadiene rubber, often blended with PVC, for insulation. It measures sales of NBR and NBR/PVC foam tubes, sheets and rolls. BY PRODUCT FORM: Tubes, Sheets & Rolls, Self-Adhesive Tapes. BY COMPOSITION: Pure NBR, NBR / PVC Blend. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, HVAC & Refrigeration Insulation, Building & Construction, Industrial & Machinery Sealing, Electronics & Appliances, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: EPDM, neoprene, silicone and FKM foams; solid nitrile rubber; polyethylene foam insulation. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
